windows.//: Code signing: set TAURI_SIGNING via CI secret. certificateThumbprint or signCommand (e.g. azuresigntool) avoids SmartScreen warnings.

macOS.//: Code signing + notarization: signingIdentity from Apple Developer cert; notarize via APPLE_ID/APPLE_PASSWORD in CI.

updater.//: Auto-update (tauri-plugin-updater). pubkey from `tauri signer generate`; private key in CI secret TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY. endpoints serve latest.json.
